verdict: Meta leads are up; Google spend needs fixing before it continues.
narrative: In the last 28 days, you received 138 leads at a cost of $15.83 per lead, all of them coming through Meta — leads are up 8.33% over the prior 7-day period and cost per lead edged down slightly. Google Ads ran through $507 over the same 28 days and produced zero conversions; the conversion tracking on that channel has a confirmed failure and spend there is being paused and corrected before it continues. Your Google Business Profile showed 83 impressions over 21 days but generated no calls or website clicks this period, and we're addressing the profile's call-to-action setup to turn visibility into responses. On the pipeline side, 130 new opportunities were created in your CRM this period but none have progressed to appointments or closed — this points to a follow-up or intake gap, not an ads issue, and that workflow is being reviewed now. Next period you can expect Google tracking to be repaired and offline conversion data flowing in, which will give a cleaner read on that channel's true performance.
